name: WANTED: Chok'sul
summary: Thelsamar's leaders seek Chok'sul's death to protect northeastern Loch Modan. Magistrate Bluntnose believes the ogre warlord directs attacks on local settlements and vital works, and offers a handsome reward for his head.

sections.title: A Threat to the Loch
sections.body: Organized ogres now threaten northeastern Loch Modan. Troggs and wild beasts have long tested the valley's borders, but these raiders bring a new danger the dwarven mountaineers cannot ignore. They have made camps in the rugged hills and moved beyond simple scavenging. Local scouts and town authorities report raids that are focused, persistent, and dangerous.

sections.title: The Price on Chok'sul's Head
sections.body: Magistrate Bluntnose believes Chok'sul directs attacks on Thelsamar, a nearby dwarven excavation site, and the Stonewrought Dam. The magistrate fears for civilian lives and the valley's great engineering work, so a bounty calls for the ogre chieftain's death by any means. His severed head is required as proof.

faq.q: Who posted the bounty on Chok'sul?
faq.answer: Magistrate Bluntnose, Thelsamar's chief civic official, posted the bounty on the town's behalf to protect the region from organized raids.

faq.q: Why is Chok'sul considered such a high priority target?
faq.answer: Chok'sul is believed to direct ogre attacks on Thelsamar, the Ironforge archaeological excavations, and the Stonewrought Dam, putting dwarven lives and vital kingdom works at risk.
Chok'sul is in an ogre encampment among the rugged hills in Loch Modan's northeastern corner.

faq.q: What proof does Magistrate Bluntnose require?
faq.answer: Magistrate Bluntnose requires Chok'sul's severed head, brought directly to him in Thelsamar, as proof for the bounty and Ironforge's gratitude.

faq.q: Why would ogres attack the Stonewrought Dam?
faq.answer: The Stonewrought Dam holds back Loch Modan's vast lake and is a great work of dwarven engineering. Sabotage could flood the wetlands and devastate dwarven supply lines, making it a valuable target for hostile forces.

faq.q: Are there other ogres working with Chok'sul?
faq.answer: Yes. Chok'sul commands an encampment of ogres in the northeastern hills, directing raids across the surrounding territory.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you see attacks on the Stonewrought Dam and nearby archaeological digs threaten your people's pride, heritage, and the security of Ironforge's lands.
As an Alliance member, you depend on Loch Modan as an agricultural and supply route into Dun Morogh. The safety of Thelsamar matters to Alliance military efforts.
As an engineer, you know the Stonewrought Dam is among the greatest works of dwarven civil engineering. Letting ogres damage it is unthinkable.
